lines.2: 「Oh, this site called Yakisoba Checkers is pretty entertaining.」
lines.3: 「It has a decent amount of information, but the real fun starts when someone trolls the message board and the administrator gets worked up arguing with them.」
lines.4: 「Then I'll troll it too. The user known as Death Mask is about to descend!」
lines.5: 「Listen, trolling is a big no-no. We can just watch and enjoy.」
lines.7: 「Huh. You came back from flashback land pretty quickly today.」
lines.8: 「Yeah. Might be a new record. There's something I wanted to tell you.」
lines.9: 「On Wednesday night, I woke up at school for some reason.」
lines.10: 「It was pitch-black, but I could hear a voice calling for me.」
lines.12: 「A-are you trying to scare me? I-I'm not scared. I'm not!」
lines.13: 「Stop clinging to my arm. You're making me hot.」
